title: corytholoma ellipticum
intro: Corytholoma ellipticum, commonly known as the Mountain pepper tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Santalaceae. The health benefits of Corytholoma ellipticum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
